definition.name: NXspm_cantilever
definition.doc:
A base class to describe the cantilever used in Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM).
The cantilever defines the probe frame, following the usual convention of cantilever beam mechanics: origin at the clamped end of the cantilever on the chip, ``x`` along the cantilever long axis from the chip towards the tip (the tip is at ``x`` = cantilever length), ``z`` normal to the cantilever and pointing away from the tip side, and ``y`` = ``z`` × ``x``. Its orientation is given by ``depends_on`` and ``transformations``.

group.name: cantilever_config
group.doc: The configuration parameters of the cantilever used in scanning probe microscopy.

group.name: phase_positioner
group.doc: The phase positioner of the cantilever.

group.name: amplitude_positioner
group.doc: The amplitude positioner of the cantilever.

field.name: depends_on
field.doc: Orientation of the probe frame in its parent frame. Points to the transformation in :ref:`transformations </NXspm_cantilever/transformations-group>` that is applied first to a direction in the probe frame.

group.name: transformations
group.doc: Rotations that orient the probe frame, typically the cantilever tilt about the ``y`` axis followed by the in-plane angle about ``z``. The position of the tip during the scan is given in the scanner frame (e.g. by the piezo sensor) and is not part of this chain.
